description: Make a sign-in link so the user connects an app account (Google, Slack, an API key…) to viaSocket. Body { "service_ids": ["<service_id>"] } answers data[] with a connection_url per app. Give the user the link, wait until they say they signed in, then call list_connections again to get the auth_id. It only makes the link; nothing is connected until the user signs in.
name: create_connection_link
